record.original_question: For a point [I] in the multigraded Hilbert scheme Hilb_H associated with the Hilbert function of d general points in projective space P^n, determine whether [I] lies in the closure Sat_H of saturated ideals or in the distinguished component Slip_H of limits of ideals of points.

evidence.quote: Problem XXXII. For a given [I] ∈ HilbH determine whether it lies in SatH or in SlipH.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n,d\ge 1$ and consider the polynomial ring $S=\mathbb{C}[x_0,\dots,x_n]$, graded in the standard way. Let $H:\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}\to\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$ be the Hilbert function of the homogeneous coordinate ring $S/I_Z$ of a set $Z$ of $d$ general points in $\mathbb{P}^n$; equivalently $H(t)=\min(\binom{t+n}{n},d)$. Let $\mathrm{Hilb}_H$ denote Haiman–Sturmfels' multigraded Hilbert scheme parametrizing homogeneous ideals $I\subset S$ with $\dim_{\mathbb{C}}(S/I)_t = H(t)$ for every $t\ge 0$.

Inside $\mathrm{Hilb}_H$ consider the two distinguished loci:
\begin{itemize}
\item $\mathrm{Sat}_H \subset \mathrm{Hilb}_H$: the closure of the set of points $[I]$ such that $I$ is a saturated homogeneous ideal (i.e.\ $I=I:\mathfrak{m}^{\infty}$ where $\mathfrak{m}=(x_0,\dots,x_n)$).
\item $\mathrm{Slip}_H \subset \mathrm{Hilb}_H$: the closure of the open locus parametrizing ideals $I(Z')$ of $d$ distinct reduced points $Z'\subset\mathbb{P}^n$ (the "limits of ideals of points" component).
\end{itemize}

Give an effective criterion that, for an arbitrary closed point $[I]\in\mathrm{Hilb}_H$, decides whether $[I]\in\mathrm{Sat}_H$ and whether $[I]\in\mathrm{Slip}_H$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Jelisiejew, "Limits of saturated ideals," J. London Math. Soc. 2025; Galgano–Ventura, "Cartwright–Sturmfels Hilbert schemes," 2024; "Limits of ideals of points in a toric variety," 2023) develops partial criteria for membership in Slip_H and studies Sat_H, but a general decision procedure for arbitrary points of Hilb_H remains open.

status_evidence.title: Limits of saturated ideals - Jelisiejew (2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the locus Sat_H of saturated ideals in the multigraded Hilbert scheme and its closure.
status_evidence.claim: Work on Sat_H is recent and ongoing; general criteria are partial.

status_evidence.title: Limits of ideals of points in a toric variety (arXiv:2306.08104)
status_evidence.snippet: Develops criteria for membership in the distinguished Slip component via morphisms of multigraded Hilbert schemes.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial criteria for membership in Slip_H are known.

status_evidence.title: Cartwright-Sturmfels Hilbert schemes (arXiv:2410.10478)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) work continuing the program of understanding components of multigraded Hilbert schemes.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of distinguishing components remains an active research area.
